title: Copyright Guide
description: The library provides copyright expertise and guidance to the university community. This guide helps make informed decisions regarding appropriate uses of copyrighted materials.

title: Data Management Guide
description: This guide helps researchers become familiar with data management practices, including data storage standards and protocols, metadata reporting requirements and best practices, and the requirements and recommendations of national funding bodies and professional associations.

title: Digital Collections
description: Digital Collections make tens of thousands of rare and unique items openly available online for research and learning.
